title: ``tool.distutils`` table
text: ['**EXPERIMENTAL** (NOT OFFICIALLY SUPPORTED): Use ``tool.distutils``', 'subtables to configure arguments for ``distutils`` commands.', 'Originally, ``distutils`` allowed developers to configure arguments for', '``setup.py`` commands via `distutils configuration files', '<https://setuptools.pypa.io/en/latest/deprecated/distutils/configfile.html>`_.', 'See also `the old Python docs <https://docs.python.org/3.11/install/>_`.']
